description: Talaix Model Registry — immutable records of proprietary indicators/methodologies. Every entry: version, methodology, scientific basis (research_registry ids), inputs, outputs, validation datasets, geographic applicability, uncertainty, limitations, validation status. A model version is never edited in place — a new version id is added. Validation status vocabulary: not_validated | validation_in_progress | validated_screening | validated_operational | deprecated.

lifecycle_states.meaning: Concept/framework stage; no executable verification expected.
Declared method producing screening indicators on real data; NOT validated; may have declared benchmark cases (config/benchmark_suite.json).
Equation- or hindcast-level verification executed and recorded (data/evaluation/runs/); not site-validated.
A validation pipeline executed on real historical data with reported metrics (data/evaluation/runs/, kind validation_pipeline) and review.
Validated AND benchmarked (benchmark suite run on record); fit for operational claims. No model reaches this without both.
Retired; reachable from any state; kept for the audit trail.

lifecycle_rule: A model's lifecycle never advances on intention or documentation alone — only on an executed evaluation run recorded under data/evaluation/runs/ (see src/climate/evaluation.py, docs/BENCHMARKS.md). Promotion is always a deliberate, reviewed, manual step.

models.lifecycle_note: Equation-verified against the cffdrs reference implementation (tests/test_fwi.py; equation_reference run recorded under data/evaluation/runs/). NOT site-validated as a fire-occurrence predictor.
models.name: Canadian FWI adapter
models.methodology: Van Wagner (1987) FWI System equations over daily Tmax/RH-noon-proxy/wind/rain series; EFFIS danger classes; verified against the cffdrs reference implementation

validation.note: Equation-level verification against the reference implementation; NOT a site-validated fire-occurrence predictor

models.geographic_applicability: Global where daily weather series exist; calibration is Canadian-system defaults
models.uncertainty: Daily aggregates approximate noon-standard inputs; reanalysis grid smoothing
models.limitations: Fire danger is not fire occurrence; fuel/terrain not part of FWI itself

models.lifecycle_note: Screening composite; validation pipeline exists (scripts/run_validation.py) but requires FIRMS_MAP_KEY and a real executed run; never auto-promoted.
models.name: Talaix composite wildfire screening score (0–100)
models.methodology: FWI-anchored static composite: real FWI + slope (DEM) + fuel moisture (Sentinel-2 NDMI or soil-moisture model) + wind; declared thresholds and factor decomposition (explain.py); NOT a probability

datasets: validation pipeline exists (scripts/run_validation.py) — FIRMS key required
validation.note: NOT VALIDATED as a predictor; printed in every report

models.geographic_applicability: Global where inputs exist; screening only
models.uncertainty: Composite weighting is declared but not empirically fitted; FMC calibration placeholder
models.limitations: Screening indicator, not a validated local fire-danger rating; not a probability of fire

models.lifecycle_note: Screening-level rate-of-spread; hindcast validator at design stage; intervention efficacy not field-validated.
models.name: Rothermel-style spread screening (baseline vs hydration intervention)
models.methodology: Rothermel-style ROS with Scott & Burgan fuel models + declared FMC-response function; baseline vs +20pt-FMC intervention comparison; evacuation safety margin

validation.note: Screening-level; hindcast validator exists (verification.py, design stage)

models.geographic_applicability: Where a fuel-model proxy can be declared from land cover
models.uncertainty: Fuel-model proxy from 10 m land cover; FMC response coefficients are declared literature placeholders
models.limitations: Surface fire only; not crown fire; intervention efficacy not field-validated

models.lifecycle_note: Relative screening indicator; evaluation path exists (scripts/evaluate_ignition.py, temporal split) — requires a real executed run; NOT a probability and NOT validated.
models.name: Relative Ignition-Likelihood Indicator
models.methodology: Declared a-priori thresholds over real FFMC + WorldPop density + OSM roads + fuel dryness; relative indicator only

datasets: evaluation path: scripts/evaluate_ignition.py (temporal split, ROC/PR-AUC, Brier) — never auto-promotes
validation.note: Explicitly NOT a probability and NOT validated

models.geographic_applicability: Where WorldPop + OSM + FWI inputs exist
models.uncertainty: A-priori thresholds are expert-declared, not fitted
models.limitations: Hazard ≠ ignition ≠ observed fire — kept strictly separate

models.lifecycle_note: Screening transport envelope; CAMS/HYSPLIT cross-check are registry candidates, not executed validations.
models.name: Smoke corridor screening transport
models.methodology: Widening-corridor envelope from real Open-Meteo wind profiles (transport level declared); observed mode (FIRMS-anchored) vs scenario mode (hypothetical fire) never mixed; confidence capped at moderate

validation.note: Screening envelope; CAMS/HYSPLIT cross-check are registry candidates

models.uncertainty: ~11 km NWP grid; single-level transport; sharp-turn self-intersections possible
models.limitations: Not a deterministic plume; no chemistry; not medical advice

models.lifecycle_note: Declared standardized-anomaly method (NOT full SPI); benchmark case bm-iberia-drought-2022 declared in config/benchmark_suite.json — see data/evaluation/ for executed run results.
models.name: Drought anomaly screening (precipitation deficit, soil moisture, ET0 balance)
models.type: proprietary index (declared subset of drought indices)
models.methodology: Standardized anomaly of accumulated precipitation over 30/90/180-day windows vs same-calendar windows of prior years (declared: NOT full SPI); ERA5-Land soil-moisture anomaly vs day-of-year climatology; ET0−P balance; dry-spell detection (<1 mm, ≥10 days)

validation.note: Declared method; not a calibrated drought index

models.uncertainty: Short baselines at some locations; reanalysis vs station differences
models.limitations: Precipitation/soil-moisture view only; not agricultural-yield impact

models.lifecycle_note: Declared percentile/spell method on real reanalysis; benchmark case bm-eu-heatwave-2022-07 declared in config/benchmark_suite.json — see data/evaluation/ for executed run results.
models.name: Extreme-heat percentile + spell detector
models.methodology: Daily Tmax percentile vs day-of-year climatology (±7-day pool, 1991–2020 baseline); heatwave spells = ≥3 consecutive days above location's own DOY p90 (WMO-style, declared)
models.uncertainty: Baseline length limited by archive start; urban heat islands unresolved at ~11 km
models.limitations: Thermal conditions only; not heat-health outcomes

models.lifecycle_note: Declared percentile method on real reanalysis; benchmark case bm-storm-eunice-2022-02 declared in config/benchmark_suite.json — see data/evaluation/ for executed run results.
models.name: Extreme-wind percentile + spell detector
models.methodology: Daily wind-gust maxima percentile vs day-of-year climatology (1991–2020); storm spells = ≥3 days above DOY p90

models.lifecycle_note: Declared percentile method on modelled GloFAS discharge + ERA5 precipitation; benchmark case bm-ahr-flood-2021-07 declared in config/benchmark_suite.json — see data/evaluation/ for executed run results.
models.name: River-discharge percentile + high-flow spells
models.methodology: Daily river discharge (GloFAS via Open-Meteo Flood API) percentile vs the location's own ~10-year series; high-discharge spells ≥2 days above declared p95; ERA5 extreme-precipitation context (3/7-day totals, antecedent index, decay 0.85)

validation.note: Declared method; GloFAS is modelled discharge, not gauge observation

models.geographic_applicability: Where a GloFAS river cell exists (honest error elsewhere)
models.uncertainty: Hydrological model uncertainty; no local gauge calibration
models.limitations: NOT flood extent, depth, or a hydraulic model; no flood forecasts

models.lifecycle_note: Screening elevation bands + labelled IPCC AR6 scenarios; not storm-surge modelling; no executed validation run.
models.name: Coastal exposure screening + labelled SLR scenarios
models.methodology: DEM low-elevation screening (declared bands, screening only) + Open-Meteo Marine waves (observed/forecast) + OSM coastal exposure; sea-level rise ONLY as PROJECTED/SCENARIO block quoting IPCC AR6 SPM Table SPM.1 approximate likely ranges
models.geographic_applicability: Coastal points (marine API coverage); elevation globally
models.uncertainty: DEM vertical accuracy; SLR global means not downscaled
models.limitations: Not storm-surge modelling; not erosion rates; not flood extents

models.lifecycle_note: Gridded WorldPop exposure estimates, never exact counts; screening overlay, no executed validation run.
models.name: Population exposure overlay (WorldPop × hazard grid)
models.methodology: WorldPop 100 m gridded estimates (reference-year labelled) overlaid on the FWI-derived risk grid → estimated population by hazard class; corridor-polygon estimates for smoke
models.geographic_applicability: Countries with WorldPop rasters (downloaded on demand)
models.uncertainty: Census vintage + dasymetric model error; hazard-grid resolution ~km

models.lifecycle_note: Declared spatio-temporal clustering heuristic over real FIRMS detections (key-gated); distinct simultaneous fires may merge; no executed validation run.
models.name: Historical fire-event derivation (FIRMS clustering)
models.methodology: Spatio-temporal clustering of real FIRMS detections (same-radius, ≤2-day gaps) into event records + ERA5 observed conditions + modelled FWI context; cause always UNKNOWN without authoritative documentation

validation.note: Declared clustering heuristic; distinct simultaneous fires may merge

models.uncertainty: Detection ≠ burned area; clustering is not perimeter mapping
models.limitations: No cause inference; no containment information

models.lifecycle_note: Conceptual framework (IPCC AR6 framing, ISO 14091 organizational reference); individual indicators carry their own lifecycle states.
models.name: Talaix analytical chain (Observation→Baseline→Anomaly→Extreme→Hazard→Exposure→Vulnerability→Impact→Risk→Compound→Cascading→Economic→Decision→Action)
models.type: conceptual framework (IPCC AR6 risk framing + ISO 14091 organizational reference — NOT ISO-certified)
models.methodology: Formal chain implemented across the platform: observed inputs are never rewritten; baselines come from the location's own series; anomalies/extremes are declared percentile/deficit methods; hazard×exposure×vulnerability compose risk; compound/cascading layers add interaction structure; economic meaning is exposure-bounded with not-quantified discipline
outputs: structured analytical payloads with claim/temporal labels

validation.note: Framework; individual indicators carry their own statuses

models.uncertainty: Per-layer uncertainties propagate; see per-model records
models.limitations: ISO 14091 is an organizational reference, NOT Talaix methodology; IPCC framing is operationalized as a declared subset
